topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session's themes, links them to previous practicals, and outlines the learning outcomes.

topics.label: Tumor viruses and the discovery of transforming oncogenes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how tumor virology led to the identification of cellular proto-oncogenes and the development of assays for cellular transformation.

topics.label: Mechanisms and classifications of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define cancer gene classifications and analyze how mutations in oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes alter protein function and cell cycle regulation.

topics.label: Origins and consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how defects in DNA repair pathways, replication proofreading, and mitotic chromosome segregation generate sequence and chromosomal instability in tumors.

topics.label: Multistep tumor progression and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how the stepwise acquisition of somatic mutations and inherited genetic predispositions accelerate tumor progression and evolution.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the presentation, invites questions, recommends reading, and previews the next lecture.
